descFull: Legend of Elya — N64 game with a real 6.36M-parameter ternary transformer on the VR4300 MIPS III CPU. Zelda-style dungeon, AI NPCs, byte-level inference at 1.23 tok/s scalar / 2.19 tok/s on the RSP overlay (measured under ares, never on silicon). Built with libdragon.
